svg.title: A scraper does not throw. It returns None.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A scraper does not throw. It returns None.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a web page with a price cell highlighted beside two selectors - a brittle chain of positional child selectors and a generated class name struck through in red, and a resilient selector anchored to the Price label ticked in green; the central failure mode where a missing element returns None rather than raising and fills a warehouse column with NULLs with no exception and no log line; the fix as one guard line that raises at the extraction boundary so a CI job goes red on the pull request; and measured parse times of 2.72 seconds for BeautifulSoup with html.parser, 2.25 with lxml, and 0.159 seconds for direct lxml XPath.
svg.text: A scraper does not throw. It returns None.
